classification: 1.3.0-rc16 TASK-204 owner test build (v2.00): plain, no PGO, no ThinLTO, CoreGS 2.0 without a pipeline compile during play. Built from the rc15 recipe (scripts/coregs2_bench/game/configure.cmd) with GT4_RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION=ON so the executable loads shaders from its own folder.
purpose: TASK-204 owner test: CoreGS 2.0 records an unknown shader variant in variants.bin instead of compiling it during play; the launcher's prepare compiles the recorded list under the TASK-170 guard. The owner reproduces the player's rc15 crash scenario (CoreGS 2.0 at 4x, a new scene mid-lap) on this build.
status: 1.3.0-rc16 test build (plain, no PGO); portable zip private/slice415-dist-task204/GT4Recomp-1.3.0-rc16-portable.zip; not a published release

ee_library.profile: aspect (the library GT4_EE_PROFILE=aspect links, verified by CMake against docs/inputs/slice217-ee-libraries.json)
ee_library.generated_units: the slice217 aspect units (private/slice217-ee-aspect-producer/generated) with the rc14 hook sites added by scripts/camera360_units.py
ee_library.recipe: scripts/coregs2_bench/game/ee_configure.cmd and ee_build.cmd (plain: clang-cl 22.1.3, SSE4.1, the derived headers of scripts/prepare_fast_headers.py, no profile)

gpu_renderer: CoreGS 2.0 (GT4_RENDERER=hw, GT4_HW_CORE=2), built in; gt4-gs is not part of this CoreGS 2.0 test build
release_distribution: GT4_RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION=ON: the executable loads the nine compute shaders from <executable folder>\shaders and fails with a clear message when the folder is missing
shader_cache: GT4_HW_SHADER_CACHE is set by the launcher (data\shader-cache); the launcher's --prepare-shaders compiles the shipped corpus and the variants the sessions recorded (variants.bin), and a play session compiles nothing (TASK-204, decision 0078)

toolchain.build: CMake/Ninja VS2022 x64 ABI Windows SDK

build_recipe: private/slice415-build/configure.cmd (the slice414/rc15 recipe with -DGT4_ASSETS_ROOT=C:/Antigravity/gt4-staticrecomp, -DGT4_EE_PROFILE=aspect, -DGT4_TARGET=v200, -DGT4_HW_GS=ON, -DGT4_RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION=ON, no PGO, no ThinLTO) and private/slice415-build/build.cmd

owner_launch.portable: extract GT4Recomp-1.3.0-rc16-portable.zip into a writable folder and start GT4Recomp.exe; Play
owner_launch.direct: gt4.exe <reconstructed ELF> --ntsc --disc "<v2.00 ISO>" --memcard <copy>.ps2 (CoreGS 2.0, GT4_HW_SHADER_CACHE required for the TASK-204 behaviour)

limits: No in-game play test yet: the owner reproduces the player's rc15 crash scenario (CoreGS 2.0 at 4x, new scenes mid-lap) on this exact build.

Spec II is not in this build (v2.00 only): the reviewed TASK-204 recipe is v2.00 and the player report is v2.00; the Spec II pair (GT4_TARGET=spec2, GT4_EE_PROFILE=spec2 and its own perf runtime capsule) is not part of this slice.
The kit carries no gt4-gs package: this is a CoreGS 2.0 build and the launcher downloads gt4-gs into its data folder when the PCSX2 GS renderer is selected (decision 0070).

The shader prepare is mandatory for specialised pipelines: a failed or skipped prepare leaves every variant on the uber pipeline (same pixels, more fragment cost) until the next Play's prepare compiles the recorded list.

A quarantined variant stays on the uber pipeline on this card and driver (its pixels are the same); the way back is deleting the shader cache folder's quarantine.bin (the launcher's support log lists it).
The headless pixel gate covers the v2.00 night race at 1x: default and GT4_CORE2_INGAME_COMPILE=1 produced 9 of 9 identical frames; other scenes, scales and drivers are the owner's in-game test.

review.note: TASK-204 owner test build of 2026-11-07 (plain, no PGO). hw_core2_* 35 of 35 and launcher 783 passed, 9 ignored on this branch; the pixel gate is 9 of 9 identical. The owner's in-game test of this exact build is pending.
